legend: You are given a permutation $$$P = (P_1, P_2, \dots, P_N)$$$ of the integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$N$$$.

For a subarray $$$P[l \dots r] = (P_l, P_{l+1}, \dots, P_r)$$$ (where $$$1 \le l \le r \le N$$$), let us define its Value as follows: $$$$$$\text{Value}(l, r) = \text{Sum}(l, r) - \text{MEX}(l, r)$$$$$$
$$$\text{MEX}(l, r)$$$ is the smallest positive integer ($$$1, 2, 3, \dots$$$) that does not appear in the subarray $$$P[l \dots r]$$$.
We call a range 3afwey if its value is as large as possible. El 3afweya is calling ..., and you have to respond. Determine the value of the 3afwey range.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$T$$$ ($$$1 \le T \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
Each testcase is structured as follows:
The first line contains an integers $$$N$$$ ($$$2 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the size of the permutation.
The second line contains $$$N$$$ space-separated integers $$$P_1, P_2, \dots, P_N$$$ ($$$1 \le P_i \le N$$$) — the initial permutation.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$N$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$
output: Print T integers, The $$$i$$$-th line should contain a single integer representing the maximum Value of a subarray of the $$$i$$$-th test case.

legend: 对于子数组$$$P[l \dots r] = (P_l, P_{l+1}, \dots, P_r)$$$(其中$$$1 \le l \le r \le N$$$），我们将其值定义为：$$$$$$\text{Value}(l, r) = \text{Sum}(l, r) - \text{MEX}(l, r)$$$$$$
$$$\text{MEX}(l, r)$$$ 是不出现在子数组 $$$P[l \dots r]$$$ 中的最小正整数 ($$$1, 2, 3, \dots$$$)。
如果一个范围的值尽可能大，我们就调用 3afwey。El 3afweya 正在调用...，你必须响应。确定 3afwey 范围的值。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$T$$$($$$1 \le T \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的结构如下：
第一行包含一个整数 $$$N$$$($$$2 \le N \le 5 \cdot 10^5$$$)——排列的大小。
第二行包含 $$$N$$$ 空格分隔整数 $$$P_1, P_2, \dots, P_N$$$($$$1 \le P_i \le N$$$)——初始排列。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$N$$$ 之和不超过 $$$5 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 打印 T 整数，$$$i$$$ 第 行应包含一个整数，该整数表示 $$$i$$$ 第 个测试用例的子数组的最大值。
